enunciado: Insert 50, 30, 70, 20, 40, 60, 80, 30 into a BST (duplicates are ignored) and show the in-order traversal, which must come out sorted. Also show the left and right children of the root.
objetivos: See that the in-order traversal of a BST is sorted
pistas: Smaller to the left, larger to the right.
If the subtree is null, that is where the new node goes.
